profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Flow
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Developer with a strong track record in the mobile industry. Skilled in iOS development (Swift, Objective-C), C#, Unity3D, Oculus Go, Augmented Reality, and Game Design. Proficient in building and optimizing mobile applications with a focus on performance and user experience. Holds a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from Brooklyn College.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Development of Revel’s iOS consumer app (ride-hailing service built with Google Maps SDK, Apollo GraphQL, Swift, and SwiftUI).
• Implemented advanced iOS features such as Live Activities, App Clips, Deferred Deep Linking, Push Notifications, and Dynamic Linking to improve user engagement and acquisition funnels.
• Integrated Firebase (Analytics, Remote Config, Crashlytics), Amplitude(FF, AB TEST) and Braze for personalized push notifications, in-app messaging, and user segmentation.
• Designed and maintained app architecture using MVVM-Coordinator, leveraging dependency injection for testability and scalability.
• Built and maintained comprehensive unit and UI test suites, using mock data and dependency injection to achieve reliable and isolated test coverage.
• Maintained CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, automating linting, unit/UI tests, and TestFlight/production deployments.
• Collaborated with backend/product teams to integrate real-time ride updates using Apollo GraphQL subscription events, along with location tracking, payment flows, and driver-passenger matching logic.
• Contributed to cross-platform development with React, Expo, and Next.js for internal driver and admin tools.
• Actively participated in code reviews, mentored junior developers, and documented best practices for performance, testing, and scalability.

📹 Video (slightly older version): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T_VuVL3nxMM

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Delivered production-grade iOS applications for enterprise and consumer clients across diverse industries.
• Selected projects:
   Carsy – Automotive services application (Swift).
   Coke AR – Immersive augmented reality marketing campaign (Unity3D).
   Asthme – Healthcare application supporting asthma patients (Swift).
   StringFlix – Social media and video-sharing platform (Objective-C).

•Partnered with design and strategy teams to ensure user experience aligned with client goals and business requirements.
•Optimized app performance, ensured App Store compliance, and implemented analytics tracking for data-driven insights.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed educational games and interactive learning apps using Unity3D and native iOS (Swift/Objective-C).
	•	Collaborated with educators, designers, and product managers to translate learning objectives into engaging digital experiences.
	•	Developed reusable code libraries, ensuring faster prototyping and reduced development cycle times.
	•	Integrated multimedia elements (animations, audio, video) to enhance interactivity and student engagement.
	•	Worked closely with QA teams to ensure product stability and compliance with accessibility standards.
	•	Optimized apps for cross-platform performance (iOS, Android, tablets).
	•	Contributed to Amplify’s Touch Press Games portfolio, which focused on interactive educational experiences.

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description:
• Developed 2D and 3D games and applications for iOS, Android, Blackberry, and PC using Unity3D / C / C++, including multiplayer and media-integrated titles.
• Optimized performance and memory usage for low-end devices and ensured cross-platform compatibility.
• Built a reusable game engine and implemented network layers for server communication.
• Integrated platform features such as Game Center, App Store, media player, and streaming video support.
•Created tools for media conversion, MIDI/MMF playback, and ringtone/wallpaper management, improving development efficiency and device support.

Utilized the ARM compiler to enable MOD file playback on BREW devices.

Developed a Flash-based educational game designed to teach Korean children English vocabulary.
